lines.text: This Hong Kong restaurant started cooking in 1860.

lines.text: Tai Ping Koon came from Guangzhou to Hong Kong in 1938.
lines.say: Tai Ping Koon came from Guangzhou to Hong Kong in nineteen thirty-eight.

lines.text: Legend says a guest called the wings sweet, and staff heard Swiss.

lines.text: The pigeon is still made the original way, fried to order.
lines.zh: 燒乳鴿仍然用古法，即叫即炸

lines.text: Then share the giant soufflé, about HK$165.
